input.title: fix(build): preserve calls edges over references on undirected collap…
input.body:
Fixes #2391.

The sort by (source, target, relation) before G.add_edge was added for deterministic collapse order, but that also meant alphabetical order picked the survivor whenever two different relations landed on the same (src, tgt) pair — references always beat calls since "calls" < "references". G.add_edge just overwrites, no merge.

Added a small _RELATION_PRIORITY table so the higher-information relation wins the collapse instead of whichever sorts last. Unlisted relations default to

output.summary: This PR fixes a bug where the deterministic sort order in `build_from_json` caused 'references' to overwrite 'calls' edges on undirected graphs, leading to loss of important call information.
output.risk_rationale: The fix changes how edge collapses are handled, which could affect the integrity of the graph data for users relying on specific edge relationships.
focus_areas: Edge collapse handling in undirected graphs
Deterministic sort order impact on edge relations
verification_targets: Ensure calls survive a collapse with references, regardless of input order
Check that the number of edges after collapse is correct for various inputs
